Patient navigation services can help guide the patient through the cancer care continuum, ensuring she receives appropriate follow-up care and support. This is particularly important given her complex diagnosis and potential bone metastasis.

Peer support groups provide emotional support and empowerment to cancer survivors. Joining such groups can help the patient connect with others who have similar experiences and improve her mental well-being.

Cancer.net offers a wealth of information on cancer treatment, side effects, and survivorship care. This resource can help the patient stay informed about her condition and available support services.
